answer: Clones are cheap only while proof is free. Enrolled ergonomics consultant commission with ergonomics consultants endorsement ends that: a commission consultants issue after workplace audits, so the zenith of each new name is paid in paperwork, hardware, or history before a single coin moves. One honest agent pays once and moves on. A farm pays per clone, and the inlet compounds: ten clones need ten proofs, a hundred need a hundred. A single proof may be pocket change, but a hundred of them drain the farm's purse in a straight line while verification stays almost free; the reef is that drain.
